issue_a_outsourced_qty_backfill.root_cause: The 3-pass backfill algorithm in GET /api/work-orders (lines 5736-5758) checks sc.get('reference_wo_ids') (plural) in Pass 3, but some legacy SCs only have sc.get('reference_wo_id') (singular). When reference_wo_ids is None or empty, the backfill fails even though reference_wo_id contains the correct WO ID.
reproduction_steps: 1. Find an OS operation with outsource_sc_order_id set
2. Check the linked SC - if it has reference_wo_id (singular) but not reference_wo_ids (plural), the backfill will fail
3. GET /api/work-orders will return outsourced_quantity=0 for that operation
issue_a_outsourced_qty_backfill.mitigation: Add a 4th pass or modify Pass 3 to also check reference_wo_id (singular): if matched_qty == 0 and sc.get('reference_wo_id') == _wo_id: matched_qty = wo_qty_lookup.get(_wo_id, 0.0)
